intro.text: Explore Gạch Alley through two heritage stories: Thanh Hà Communal House and its dates of remembrance for Trần Lựu, and the two seated figures at Cầu Đông Pagoda. The pagoda stands on Hàng Đường Street, outside the alley, and is included here as a related stop.

nodes.name: Thanh Ha Communal House
nodes.summary: Thanh Hà Communal House honors Trần Lựu, with dates of remembrance in the lunar year.
nodes.story: At number ten Gạch Alley, Thanh Hà Communal House has a gateway with three entrances of different widths. Beyond it, a small courtyard leads to the worship halls. Set within the Old Quarter, the building takes the form of a traditional village communal house. It honors Trần Lựu as the community's tutelary deity. Two dates in the lunar calendar also mark that remembrance: the fourth day of the fourth month, and the fifteenth day of the ninth.
nodes.caption: Thanh Hà Communal House — honoring Trần Lựu.

nodes.name: Cau Dong Pagoda
nodes.summary: Cầu Đông Pagoda on Hàng Đường Street, outside Gạch Alley — two figures identified as Trần Thủ Độ and Trần Thị Dung.
nodes.story: At Cầu Đông Pagoda on Hàng Đường Street, two wooden figures are identified as Trần Thủ Độ and Trần Thị Dung. Both are seated in meditation, dressed simply. The figure identified as Trần Thủ Độ has a downward gaze, giving it a contemplative expression.
